propositions: Read-only derivations over plan/code-review sidecars must extract llm_calls and latency metrics exclusively from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block.
cost_per_accepted_change is computed as total llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when there are zero accepted closes.
first_pass_verification measures the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record in chronological order is a completion_verifier_pass_v1.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 record with the next same-gate PASS record on the ticket stream, computing interval as PASS timestamp minus ERROR timestamp; unmatched ERRORs remain open.

Metrics reader performs raw ordered scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files sorted by event_sort_key, inspecting data.schema and data.verdict to distinguish record types without using reducer-filtered helpers.
All derived metrics register into the metrics registry with source='sidecar' and confidence='high'.
